senses.gloss: c. (palatium, παλάτιον) palace. [Targ. Lam. IV, 1, read with ed. Lag. פִּיטָלוֹן.] Targ. Y. II, Gen. XII, 15 (Ar. פַּלְטוֹרִין). Targ. II Esth. I, 9; a. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:12">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>לפ׳ גדולה וכ׳</he> like a large palace with many entrances. Y. Sabb. X, 12ᶜ <he>אין גדולה בפ׳ של מלך</he> in the king’s palace (the Temple) no rank is recognized (all are alike); a. v. fr.—Pl. same.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 47:27">Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 27</cite>.—V. <cite ref="Q01030"><he>פַּלְטֵרִין</he></cite>
